prompt: CSS flexbox main size depends on cross size auto indefinite substitute
answer:
When calculating a flex item’s flex base size, if the main size depends on the cross size and the cross size is `auto` and indefinite, Flexbox uses `fit-content` as the cross-size substitute. The resulting main size becomes the flex base size. This is specified in the Flexbox layout algorithm, §9.2, step 2E:

> “If a cross size is needed to determine the main size … and the flex item’s cross size is auto and not definite, in this calculation use fit-content as the flex item’s cross size.”

If the item has an intrinsic aspect ratio, a `content` flex basis, and a definite cross size, the main size is instead calculated from the cross size and aspect ratio. (W3C CSS Flexible Box Layout Module, §9.2.)
